protocol.balance_note: Selection runs at 10,000 because at the requested 1,000 the 10-barrel lot step, not the signal, decides which cells trade at all. Every winner is reported at both balances.
protocol.bars: usoil_1m causally aggregated to 30m; out-of-session buckets used only for the overnight and gap anchors
protocol.clock: usoil_1m is New York wall-clock, established from the empty 17:00 maintenance hour and the 09:00 / 10:30 / 14:27-14:29 volume peaks; no timestamp is converted
protocol.contract: Exness USOIL: 1000 barrels a lot, 0.01 lot minimum, so quantity is in barrels and the step is 10 barrels
protocol.cost_note: 0.20 a barrel charged wholly at entry, as specified. Zero-account commission (6.25 a lot = 0.00625 a barrel) is inside that, so this is the conservative side.
protocol.selection_gate: >=6 of 7 in-sample years profitable; selected DD 8.0-20.0%; annual DD <=22.0%; >=300 trades ({'eia': 150}); PF >=1.05; the volatility and trend filters must refine an already profitable unfiltered cell; >=60% of numeric neighbours robust
protocol.session: 09:00-14:30 New York (the WTI pit session); entries inside it only, forced flatten at the close
protocol.sizing: fixed risk 0.015 of equity, vol target 0.4, floored to the 10-barrel lot step inside 25% margin; not searched, so it can be rescaled to a drawdown budget afterwards
